steps.name: Monday 5 January, 10:00: Tidelink starts moving its uploads to Cloudflare R2
The World: Maya's Cloudflare user and her password (the dashboard's stand-in for Cloudflare's sign-up)
The World: Tidelink's account, Maya its Super Administrator, and the World application's account token (the credential door, the sign-up no API makes)
She logs in with her email and password; the dashboard takes her on to R2's API tokens page
She creates her own Account API token, "maya-admin", with Admin Read & Write, and copies its Access Key ID and Secret Access Key from the page, which shows them once
